cmd_start:
👋 Hi! I'm a group administration bot for Telegram.

Add me to a group and grant admin rights. Features:
• Moderation: /ban /kick /mute /warn
• Captcha for new members
• Antispam: links, forwards, stopwords
• Customizable welcome messages

/help — command list.
cmd_help_private:
📖 Commands:
/start — welcome
/help — this help

Add me to a group and use /help there to see moderation commands (admins only).
cmd_info: ℹ️ Group administration bot Commands for everyone: • /scam — check a seller against the scam list • /info — this help • /help — command list ⚠️ Safety rules: • Always /scam a seller before a deal • Use an escrow for large amounts • Report scammers in the Scam-list thread (https://t.me/whitelistsmarket/32) or DM @wem1r0 For admins: /menu, /addtowl, /ban, /mute, /warn and more.
cmd_help_group:
📖 Moderation commands (admins only):

/ban [duration] [reason] — ban
/unban — unban
/kick — remove without ban
/mute [duration] [reason] — mute
/unmute — unmute
/warn [reason] — warn
/unwarn — remove last warning
/warns — show warnings

⚙️ Settings:
/settings — current settings
/menu — settings menu with buttons
/welcome on|off, /setwelcome <text>
/captcha on|off, /setcaptcha button|math|emoji
/setwarnlimit <N>, /setwarnaction mute|kick|ban [duration]
/antispam links|forwards|stopwords on|off
/antiflood on|off | <limit> <window> [mute|kick|ban]
/newbie on|off | <seconds>
/addstop <word>, /delstop <word>, /stopwords
/addtrigger <phrase> | <reply>, /deltrigger <phrase>, /triggers [on|off]

📊 Statistics:
/stats [on|off] — my stats / toggle tracking
/top [N] — most active users

📅 Scheduled posts:
/schedule <in> [<interval>] | <text>
/schedules — list, /unschedule <id>

🌐 Federation (shared bans):
/fcreate <name>, /fjoin <id>, /fleave, /finfo
/fban <who> [reason], /funban <who>
dm_menu_welcome:
👋 Welcome! This is the seller-check and group-moderation bot.

Pick an action from the menu below:
dm_scam_prompt:
🔎 Send the seller's @username or numeric ID, or reply to the seller's message.

Example: @someuser or 123456789
dm_groups_empty: 👥 No groups yet — add the bot to a group and grant it admin rights.
dm_action_prompt: {action}: send the user's @username or ID, or reply to the user's message.
dm_action_prompt_duration: {action}: send the user's @username or ID (you can include a duration and reason, e.g.: @user 2h spam). Or reply to a message.
dm_rt_check_prompt:
🔎 Send the seller's @username or numeric ID, or reply to the seller's message.

Example: @someuser or 123456789
dm_rt_wl_prompt: ⭐ Send the seller's @username or ID to add them to the whitelist, or reply to their message.
dm_rt_wlrm_prompt: 🚫 Send the seller's @username or ID to remove them from the whitelist, or reply to their message.
dm_rt_list_empty: 📋 The list is empty — nobody is flagged or whitelisted.
dm_sm_prompt:
⏱ Group slow mode.

{current}

Format: on|off [regular hours] [WL hours]
Example: on 6 3 — regular 6h, WL 3h. (1 to 720 hours)
dm_sm_bad: ❌ Invalid format. Example: on 6 3 or off.
dm_sm_topics_prompt: Choose the topics where the rule applies (or «All topics»):
dm_bc_groups_title: 📣 Pick a group to broadcast to:
dm_bc_no_topics: 📭 This group has no topics (forum) to broadcast to.
dm_bc_none: ❌ Pick at least one topic first.
dm_bc_text_prompt: ✍️ Send the text to broadcast to the selected topics.
